name: insightly-se-mcp-internal
description: Drive Insightly demo environments from Claude in plain English — full read/write, fast paging, and search.
long_description: Internal Solutions-Engineering tool. Talk to any Insightly demo env in plain English: list/search/create/update/annotate records across every object, with paginated results, an opt-in fetch_all, a real total count, and client-side contains filtering. One-click install: paste your Insightly API key into the secure field below — no config files, no Terminal JSON editing.

api_key.title: Insightly API key
api_key.description: Insightly → User Settings → API (any demo env). Stored securely by Claude; never shown in chat.

pod.title: Insightly pod
pod.description: The region in your API URL — na1 (North America), eu1, or ap1.

uv_path.title: Path to uv
uv_path.description: The uv runner. In Terminal run `which uv`: Apple Silicon + Homebrew is /opt/homebrew/bin/uv; Intel Homebrew is /usr/local/bin/uv; the standalone installer uses ~/.local/bin/uv. Install uv first if needed: brew install uv.

tools.name: env_summary
tools.description: One-call overview: real record counts across core objects.

tools.name: describe_object
tools.description: Field reference: standard + custom fields with types and dropdown options.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: List records for any object (paged envelope; fetch_all; count_total).

tools.name: find_by_email
tools.description: Find records by exact email address.

tools.name: filter_records
tools.description: Client-side contains filter over a capped scan.

tools.name: create_records
tools.description: Batch-create up to 50 records in one call (demo seeding).

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Attach a note to a record.

tools.name: connection_info
tools.description: Show auth state, pod, and server version.

tools.name: raw_request
tools.description: Escape hatch for any v3.1 endpoint.
